name: Salesforce
one_liner: Cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) platform for managing sales, customer service, and business workflows.
self_serve_basis: Free Salesforce Developer Edition accounts can be created instantly, offering immediate access to full API functionality and Connected App configuration.
api_breadth_note: Extremely broad, supporting standard/custom data objects, metadata, tooling, analytics, user administration, and pub/sub streaming APIs.
mcp_note: Community-maintained MCP servers are available to connect AI models to Salesforce APIs.

name: HubSpot
one_liner: Customer relationship management (CRM) platform offering sales, marketing, and customer service APIs.
self_serve_basis: Developers can sign up for a free HubSpot Developer Account instantly and create private apps or OAuth apps to generate API tokens.
api_breadth_note: Extremely broad, covering CRM objects (contacts, deals, companies, tickets), custom objects, marketing automation, CMS, workflows, and webhooks.
mcp_note: Multiple community-maintained MCP servers exist for interacting with HubSpot CRM contacts, companies, deals, and tasks.
